episodes.title: 23: A Black Sheep's Journey: Confidence to Leave the Cult
episodes.description: In today's episode, Kressyn leads us through her inspiring journey from a restrictive upbringing to becoming a beacon of empowerment and light. In this heartfelt conversation, she reflects on her childhood experiences and how they've shaped her into the incredible woman she is today. Kressyn has always felt like the black sheep of her family, often struggling against the strict expectations placed upon her. "I just knew from a very young age that something is wrong here," she states, revealing her inner conflict between conforming and seeking her truth. As she ventured into adulthood, Crescent grappled with the fear of losing her family's support while pursuing her own identity. "I almost had to pick between the two," she admits, emphasizing the pain of choosing between familial bonds and self-fulfillment. Her journey illustrates the importance of prioritizing one's own well-being in the face of adversity.
